plan: This auction functions like a second-price auction: the winner pays the second-highest bid (the clock stops when the second-highest bidder exits at their sealed bid). With independent private values and no information about others' bids, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. This ensures I win whenever my value exceeds others' values, paying only the second-highest bid, maximizing expected profit without risk of overpaying.

Since this is effectively a second-price auction (the winner pays the highest competing bid, not their own), the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding truthfully ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the market price, and I never pay more than my value, guaranteeing non-negative profit. Bidding higher risks paying more than my value; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Thus, I will bid exactly $20, my private value.
